directive: JAYT-135R — INVALID CAPTURE CONTAINMENT & EVIDENCE-FIRST REBUILD
executive_ruling: CEO independent audit discovered that Batch 135 was contaminated by flawed collector and classifier implementations. Entire batch is formally rejected as supply evidence and quarantined.

root_causes.description: Collector generated synthetic placeholder text when network timed out ('OFFLINE_CACHE_OR_TIMEOUT') rather than marking status as BLOCKED/INCOMPLETE.
Classifier assigned ACTIVE_VERIFIED status and terms by matching target_id rather than parsing and extracting verbatim quotes from actual physical DOM.
DanaBus 6.000₫ claim was assigned despite the captured page ending at an error URL (Error.aspx).
Batch lacked full DOM page.html snapshots and viewport screenshot.png visual evidence proofs.

remediation_directive: JAYT-136: Real browser evidence supply batch with zero synthetic fallbacks, mandatory page.html/page.txt/screenshot.png, and 100% verbatim quote extraction.
